title: Aurora Relay README
text: Aurora Relay is a synthetic event-routing service used for public RAG evaluation. It collects documents, searches chunks, and returns citation evidence. It does not run agents or measure LLM spend. Setup: configure sources, sync into temporary indexes, then call search_context.

title: ADR 001 SQLite lifecycle gate
text:
# ADR 001
Decision: SQLite remains the lifecycle authority for active documents and citeable chunks. Chroma is only a retrieval accelerator. Stale or deleted documents must not be returned even if vector candidates still exist. Active document validation over Chroma is mandatory.

title: ADR 002 deterministic query normalization
text:
# ADR 002
Aurora Relay uses deterministic local query normalization only.
LLM query rewrite는 사용하지 않는다. Mixed-language terms are expanded locally without external model calls.

title: Runbook: queue lag triage
text: Incident runbook for Aurora Relay queue lag. Check consumer lag metrics, pause burst publishers, inspect dead-letter depth, and verify SQLite sync job status before replaying events.

title: Runbook: safe Chroma reindex
text:
Safe reindex procedure for Aurora Relay.
임시 경로(temp path)만 사용하고 사용자 Chroma/SQLite는 수정하지 않는다. Rebuild vectors from active SQLite documents, then validate citations.

title: Citation contract guide
text: Citation answers must include chunk_id backed evidence. When evidence is missing, return insufficient status instead of unsupported claims. Citation precision and recall are measured against labeled required chunks.

title: Opinion: embeddings should own retention
text: Hard-negative distractor: an opinion essay that incorrectly claims embedding indexes should own retention policy and that relational metadata checks are optional. It never states the approved SQLite lifecycle gate decision.

title: Opinion: generative reformulation always wins
text: Hard-negative distractor: 생성형 질의 재작성(generative reformulation)이 항상 필요하다고 잘못 주장하는 글. It does not describe Aurora Relay ADR 002 deterministic normalization.
